verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The offline install mode in bun-docs-5 controls registry and tarball network access, which is a different feature from opting out of usage tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
